query:
UPDATE users
         SET failed_logins = failed_logins + 1,
             locked_until = CASE
                 WHEN failed_logins + 1 >= $2 THEN now() + LEAST(
                     make_interval(mins => power(2, LEAST(failed_logins + 1 - $2, 6))::int),
                     interval '1 hour')
                 ELSE locked_until
             END
         WHERE id = $1 AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until <= now())
         RETURNING id
